title: Add inventory movement and stagnant-stock report
description: Add a read-only inventory movement and stagnant-stock report derived from the existing StockMovement ledger and current stock records. Use explicit base-unit and reversal semantics, keep unavailable history visible as unknown, and do not add production schema, estimate inventory cost, or mutate inventory data.
acceptance_criteria: Users can filter the report by warehouse, product, as-of date, movement window and inactivity threshold.
The report exposes current base-unit quantity, last authoritative movement date, inbound quantity, outbound quantity and inactivity days using documented ledger semantics.

Reversal or signed movement records are netted consistently without double-counting, and products without sufficient movement history are identified explicitly rather than assigned invented dates or rates.
Stagnant-stock classification follows the requested inactivity threshold and does not infer cost valuation from unavailable data.
Queries are bounded or paged and avoid per-row database queries for normal report use.
Unit/integration tests cover active stock, stagnant stock, reversals, no-history records and filters; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open the inventory movement report, apply warehouse and date filters, and verify base-unit movement totals.
Apply an inactivity threshold and verify stagnant and insufficient-history rows are presented distinctly.

human_gate.reason: Read-only reporting over existing stock and movement records; no schema, production data mutation, deployment or release.
